scope: Development/calibration MiVOLO CPU age diagnostics using frozen YuNet boxes; no held-out age inference, threshold calibration or G3 acceptance.

observations.training_cohort_overlap: Unknown; proprietary and open training data versions and overlap with local subjects are not established.

evaluator.body_mode: Original processor(images=[None]) normalized black tensor; retain six input channels
evaluator.loading: Direct fixed local classes, use_safetensors=True, local_files_only=True, torch_dtype=float32; reject missing/unexpected/mismatched/error loading entries

crop.detections: Reuse the exact pinned identity report boxes/statuses only; do not use SFace features as age inputs or re-run detection
crop.frame: Decode pinned original bytes using EXIF-corrected RGB; require dimensions equal to frozen detection dimensions; convert crop RGB to BGR for the original MiVOLO processor
crop.bounds: [max(0,floor(x)), max(0,floor(y)), min(width,ceil(x+w)), min(height,ceil(y+h))]; require nonempty rectangle
crop.alignment: No landmark warp; original processor classification letterbox and normalization only
crop.failures: Retain every requested image; reused NO_FACE and all new input/crop/prediction failures have null age estimates

statistics.original_errors: Only original-role images, research filename age labels: signed error=prediction-label; report identity-macro MAE, bias, and sqrt(mean(identity mean squared error)) separately within each of the two allowed groups, for all ages and each of the six fixed age strata (14 summaries); no cross-group pooling
statistics.within_identity: Retain all 517 same-identity original pairs, including two same-age pairs; prediction_delta_error=(right prediction-left prediction)-(right label-left label); summarize absolute/signed/squared delta error by subject within group and same/cross-age
statistics.generated: All 37 source_generated_comparison requests, separate same_age_control/other_condition/unknown_source_age; report prediction shift, generated condition deviation, static source condition deviation, and paired reduction in absolute condition deviation. Requested target age is a condition, never ground truth.
statistics.paired_generated_scoring: All conditional metrics share the pair-complete-case set: require both source and generated predictions, while retaining individual image estimates separately.
statistics.macro: Average scored observations inside each subject (or source for generated comparisons), then equally weight effective units; retain requested/scored/null and eligible/effective unit counts. All-failed and zero-request means remain null.

bootstrap.unit: Subject or source, never individual images/pairs; sample effective unit metric vectors with replacement using the same draws for paired metrics
bootstrap.unit_order: Effective units sorted lexicographically by subject/source ID
bootstrap.index_draw: For each replicate, call rng.randrange(n_effective_units) n_effective_units times; reuse that index vector across every metric
bootstrap.interval: Percentile 2.5/97.5 with sorted linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; one effective unit gives a degenerate interval and explicit unit count; no interval for zero units
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional descriptive uncertainty for this cohort and scored units, not independent validation or missingness correction

integrity: Verify bounded image snapshots before decode, then after all scoring/aggregation; changed inputs lose estimates and dependent metrics are recomputed. Recheck fixed model, source artifacts, metadata, implementation pins and environment; drift rejects successful publication.
output_policy: Ignored report.json with all 194 requests, 517 within-identity and 37 conditional comparisons, aggregates and bootstrap intervals; no images, crops or demographic classifications
